allow: PowerShell($g = \(Get-Command go -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($g\) { $g.Source } else { "go not on PATH"; Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\Go\\bin","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Go\\bin" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName })
PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'docker','go','podman'\) { $p = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "$c -> $\($p.Source\)" } else { "$c -> missing" } })
